text:
Maya: Quick readout from 5 user tests today. People click the quickstart banner expecting a short checklist. The slim rail didn't surface that.
Owen: lab notes mirror that. Rail is subtle and keeps users exploring, modal forces completion but blocks discovery.
Priya: metric flag: onboarding completion fell ~6% after we swapped to rail-only. Suspect CTA copy confusion.
Leo: accessibility audit: rail CTA contrast is 3.7:1 on light theme. Keyboard order also jumps past it. Needs tabindex and color updates.
Maya: copy ideas to trial: "Create demo project", "Start setup checklist", "Try a sample project". Prefer explicit intent.
Owen: also add tiny helper line under CTA: "Includes sample prompts and deploy script  3 min".
Priya: suggestion: hybrid approach  keep rail for discovery + show an inline 3-bullet preview (Invite team, Deploy sample, Run test prompt). Add a "Full setup" action that opens modal.
Leo: a11y fixes: give rail role="region" with aria-label, ensure focusable CTA via single Tab, visible focus ring, bump contrast to >=4.5:1. Quick CSS:
```
.entry-rail .cta { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); color: #05204a; }
```
OnboardBot: Prototype link updated by @Leo  https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/onboard-entry-v5 (variant A/B copy).
Maya: telemetry plan: events -> onboard_rail_cta_click, onboard_preview_open, onboard_modal_open, onboard_rail_dismiss. Experiment rule: hide rail for 14 days after dismissal.
Priya: also persist user preference for "always show modal" for Dedicated customers to avoid repeated prompts.
Owen: eng estimate: ~3 dev days (copy + contrast + tabindex + telemetry hooks), modal reuse is small.
Maya: if estimate slips <2 days we try next sprint, else schedule following. I'll make tickets and attach Figma + accessibility screenshots. Thanks all :)
